name: Koi-Koi Onsen Monogatari
source:
The hot spring resort Tokoharu Koi-Koi Hot Spring is a ryokan famous for its plum and cherry trees, which bloom all year round.However, a mysterious storm caused the two trees to lose all their beautiful blooms a few years ago.
The ryokan now faces a crisis—will it have to close down?

Having inherited this ryokan, you meet two sisters there who you discover to be old childhood friends.
—The cool and composed older sister Koume, and shy younger sister Sakura.
Spending time under the same roof, the three of you work towards restoring the ryokan to its former glory.

The innkeeper Itsuha tells you something completely unexpected.
The key to making the plum and cherry trees bloom again is forming a connection with the two sisters in both body and soul!
Do you choose just one of the girls, or perhaps both? It's up to you!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368670]Steam[/url]]
translation:
温泉度假村常春恋恋温泉是一家以梅树和樱花树而闻名的旅馆，一年四季都盛开着花朵。然而，几年前一场神秘的暴风雨导致这两棵树失去了所有美丽的花朵。
这家旅馆现在面临危机——是否必须倒闭？

继承了这家旅馆后，你在那里遇到了两姐妹，你发现她们是儿时的老朋友。
——冷静沉着的姐姐小梅和害羞的妹妹小樱。
在同一屋檐下度过的时光，你们三人致力于恢复旅馆昔日的辉煌。

旅馆老板五叶告诉你一些完全出乎意料的事情。
让梅树和樱花重新绽放的关键是与两姐妹在肉体和灵魂上建立联系！
你只选择其中一个女孩，还是两个都选择？由你决定！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2368670]Steam[/url]]
